clusters.pick_reason: PR #2259 is a strict superset of #2253: it adds the same SSE-writer teardown and shutdown loop, but also adds an idempotency guard (`if self._terminated: return`) that prevents double-termination races. The diff in #2259 omits the `# pragma: no cover` on the writer loop (making it testable), whereas #2253 marks it as uncovered. No functional regression risk over #2253.

members.title: fix: terminate active StreamableHTTP sessions during shutdown
members.author: weiguangli-io
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2259: Active SSE stream writers are not closed before session tasks are cancelled during shutdown, causing Uvicorn to log ASGI incomplete-response errors. Both PRs fix this by iterating `_sse_stream_writers` in `terminate()` and calling `writer.close()`, then add a pre-cancellation loop over active sessions in the `lifespan` finally block of `streamable_http_manager.py`.
